# 1000.00 USD bought for 1350.00 CAD, the USD split's amount left to `$residual$`.
#
# The transaction is in USD. The CAD split is valued -1000.00 USD, so the USD
# split takes +1000.00 USD. That split states `cost_basis_balance: 1500.00`:
# 500.00 USD more than it brings in, currency the book never held.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal, since a cost basis cannot have more
# available than it acquired.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_stated_balance_is_checked.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 1000 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD $residual$ USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		cost_basis_balance: 1500.00
	Assets:Bank -1350.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		value: "-1000.00"
